articles.title: New Cat Species Discovered in Bolivia After Being Mistaken for a Kitten
articles.summary: A new breed of cat has been discovered for the first time in 100 years. Citing the journal Current Biology, NBC News reports that a new wild cat species dubbed leopardus tilcayo (or the tilcayo tiger cat) was discovered in the Bolivian Yungas.
body: The tilcayo tiger cat is smaller than the average house cat, has rounded ears, a slender build, and is spotted.

Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, the co-author of Current Biology’s study, came upon the cat while volunteering for a wildlife rehabilitation center in Bolivia and thought it looked just different enough to warrant further investigation.

“The cat had been brought in by a man living in a community in the forest near La Paz who had mistaken the cat for a domestic kitten, according to details recorded by the sanctuary,” NBC reports. “He had fed the animal noodles, rice and eggs, only to realize it was wild and that he could not take care of it. So he brought it to the sanctuary.”
It was originally believed to have been a known species of wild cat, but Nogales-Ascarrunz conducted genetic testing that ultimately determined this was its own distinct cat species.
points: A new breed of cat has been discovered for the first time in 100 years.

articles.title: Helldivers Movie Eyes Reacher's Alan Ritchson as Its Star
articles.summary: Reacher star Alan Ritchson is reportedly in talks to star in PlayStation's upcoming Helldivers movie. As reported by Deadline, the feature film adaptation of Arrowhead Game Studios' brutal multiplayer hit is zeroing in on a new lead after Aquaman actor Jason Momoa exited the project earlier this…
body: Ritchson has emerged as one of the more memorable action faces in the last decade. Although he's best known as the face of Prime Video's Reacher series, he's also shown up in Supergirl, Titans, and Fast X. Most recently, viewers may recognize him from his work in Netflix's War Machine or in this month's Owen Wilson movie, Runner.

Plot details for the Helldivers movie remain tightly under wraps as the crew tries to pin Ritchson behind the scenes. Sony announced plans to bring the battle for Super Earth to the big screen back in January 2025, and although things seemed to be progressing smoothly enough since, a few snags have kept it from landing.

For example, Lin, the director behind some The Fast and the Furious movies, boarded Helldivers in December of last year. Momoa then followed as Sony nailed down a release date in February of this year.

As much sense as it would make to see Momoa buzzing through Terminids and Automatons in the name of liberty, the DC and Game of Thrones star was said to have bailed on Helldivers in June. Why he departed the movie still remains unclear, though fans probably aren't too beaten up over the idea now that Ritchson could be the one to suit up.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Could Take 100 Hours To Beat, And Its Director Has Done It 46 Times
articles.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is shaping up to be the biggest entry in the remake trilogy by a considerable margin, as game director Naoki Hamaguchi estimates that a complete playthrough of everything that the game has to offer could take up to 100 hours.
body: This is all part of the job; to ensure that players enjoy a smooth experience, the developers have to check every part of the game for any potential issues. "In a standard playthrough from beginning to end, if I were to review and check every single asset and element in the game, it'll easily take over a hundred hours," Hamaguchi said to GameSpot. "Obviously, I can't do that in each and every single playthrough. As the director, I don't have enough time for that, so sometimes I would just skip combat and focus on checking the main story. In different playthroughs, I focus on different elements."

In total, Hamaguchi said he had completed 46 playthroughs by the time he was interviewed. So how do you get so many game completions under your belt, when the game in question is so lengthy? Hamaguchi explained that he'd devoted all his time to playtesting the game, and he even slipped in a few testing sessions between interviews on the current Final Fantasy 7 Revelation press tour.

articles.title: Mega Man: Dual Override Preview: We Played as Proto Man This Time
articles.summary: Proto Man offers a distinctly different challenge than Mega Man. Not necessarily harder, just different. It’s worth noting that you won’t be switching back and forth between the two; at the start of your playthrough you’ll select which character to control for the entire run, offering some…
body: 2027 is a big year for Mega Man. Everyone’s favorite little blue robot turns the big 40. That’s a major milestone, and few active franchises in all of gaming can celebrate that kind of longevity. As part of the festivities, we are getting a new mainline entry in the series in Mega Man: Dual Override. At Tokyo Game Show 2026 we had a chance to go hands-on in this robotic adventure, and found a traditional 2D shooter/platformer like the series is best known for, but with some modern twists.

Similar to Simon Cardy’s excellent preview, I would be taking on Twinkle Girl, and her lineup of stages. But this time, I’d be ditching the Blue Bomber in favor of his older brother, occasional foe, and sometimes ally Proto Man. For those who don’t know, Proto Man was the first of Dr. Light’s sentient robot creations, who long ago abandoned the good doctor to forge his own path. He’s flawed, a bit aloof, and cool as hell. Just look at those built in sunglasses!

articles.title: People Can’t Stop Talking About Mario’s New Tiny Pockets
articles.summary: Nintendo recently held two Direct presentations back to back, with fans hoping that the company would reveal a new Mario game of some kind. While that didn't happen, what we did get was the reveal that Mario Kart World is getting some new tracks.
body: It seems that over the last day or so, Nintendo quietly updated the look of the "Super Mario" logo. Honestly, the change is subtle. The colors are the same, just a little less vibrant and a little more gradient. The logo is also on one line instead of stacked, as it has been for the last 30 years or so.

The big "change," though, is in Mario's look. In a passing glance, you might not notice anything different. The mustache is still there. The gloves haven't gone anywhere. The hat looks the same. Everything appears to be in order. But look closer.

It's tiny, but on his waist is a... pocket? Yes, Nintendo added functional pockets to the red plumber's overalls, which is great! I always wondered where those flowers and mushrooms went, and now it makes sense. He just stores them in his small pockets.

Unfortunately, if he had a Kingdom Phone--or whatever the smartphone equivalent would be in the Mushroom Kingdom--I'm sure that wouldn't fit in these pockets, especially if it was a foldable device like the newly announced iPhone Duo. I guess Mario can't play Mario Kart Tour before it shuts down forever on September 29.
points: Nintendo recently held two Direct presentations back to back, with fans hoping that the company would reveal a new Mario game of some kind.
While that didn't happen, what we did get was the reveal that Mario Kart World is getting some new tracks.

articles.title: Sony’s Iconic PS4 Game-Sharing Meme Has Been Recreated To Capture Our Depressing Future
articles.summary: Thirteen years ago, Sony "won" E3 with a simple public service announcement that dunked on Microsoft's controversial Xbox One DRM plans. All it took was 22 seconds for Sony's Shuhei Yoshida and Adam Boyes to show how game sharing would work on the PS4, resulting in a huge PR win for the company.
body: The original video from Sony--which was infamously put together at the last second--showed just how easy it was for PS4 owners to share physical games, compared with the frequent DRM checks that were initially planned for Xbox One games. Boyes left Sony in 2016, while Yoshida said he was "fired" from his role as SIE worldwide president in 2019, and he departed in 2025 after several years of leading Sony's Independent Developer Initiative.

Things have changed drastically since the two left, as Sony announced several months ago that it would cease production of game discs, an announcement that has not gone over well with its users and third-party partners. Sony's reasoning is that with the lion's share of game sales being digital, it can afford to move toward an all-digital future, which also has several positive knock-on effects for its business.

articles.title: A Lot Of People Are Seemingly Taking Time Off Work To Play GTA 6. Are You?
articles.summary: BambooHR, a human resources company that provides software-as-a-service for more than 30,000 companies, has released data that suggests people are taking time off to play GTA 6 this November.
body: You might have seen anecdotes online, or even stories from people you know in real life, about skipping work on November 19 to play GTA 6. BambooHR's data, though, shows a more concrete trend.

Using paid time off (PTO) data from active employees in the US, BambooHR found that PTO requests for the third Thursday of November this year--the day that GTA 6 launches--are running 9-17% above historical averages from recent years.
This data is consistent "at every checkpoint we can measure," the company said in a memo sent to GameSpot.

GTA 6 launches on a Thursday. There is no word on PTO data for the following day, but who wants to go back to work on a Friday? I would theorize people might book that day off, too, but BambooHR didn't share any data for this. A playthrough of the game can take 80 hours to complete, so it's good at least that people can roll right into the weekend and keep playing.

articles.summary: Brad Pitt is ready for more zombie-filled adventures. On Friday, Paramount Pictures officially announced Pitt will return for a sequel to World War Z, the 2013 zombie apocalypse movie that made over $540 million at the worldwide box office.
body: The World War Z sequel will reunite the pair after Pitt starred in Berger's upcoming The Riders, which recently finished shooting. According to Deadline, Pitt pitched Berger on a World War Z sequel early on while filming The Riders. "By end of production, Berger was on board and in recent weeks the studio was able to close the deal with both talents to board the project," Deadline reported.

Paramount has not shared any details about the new movie's plot at this time. The original World War Z adapted Max Brooks' 2006 novel of the same name. A sequel was planned after World War Z 's successful box office run, and even given a 2017 release date, but never entered production. Like so many Hollywood movies, it got stuck in development hell, and was ultimately canceled.

At CinemaCon in April, Paramount announced a World War Z sequel was in the works, but didn't share any details beyond that. Reportedly, World War Z was one of three franchises (along with Top Gun and Star Trek ) Paramount was looking to prioritize for the big screen.

articles.title: Is there romance in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave?
articles.summary: Romance in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave sounds like a reasonable idea considering the vast roster you can recruit. In the game, the relationship between characters is represented by their support level.
body: Since in the series' previous games, you had to go through many steps to unlock "romantic endings," you may want to know if there's romance in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. Below, we explain everything you need to know about it.

Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave does not feature a romance system like Fire Emblem: Three Houses' romance system. However, it doesn't mean that the game's story doesn't portray characters as romantically interested in others or being straight-up flirtatious.

As you play the game and raise a character's support level, you can unlock up to three support conversations — rank C, B, and A scenes. In some of these dialogues, you might see characters demonstrating their affection for each other. For example, Esmeralda won't hide her love for Dietrich from the beginning of the game. Even during the main quest, specific characters will explicitly engage in romantic interactions.

Even so, you won't find a romance system where you can choose and watch your favorite characters in a romantic scene. The closest Fortune's Weave gets to Three Houses ' S-Rank romance is the paired ending with Eshmel, the protagonist, but the scenes we played didn't have romance in them.
points: Romance in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave sounds like a reasonable idea considering the vast roster you can recruit.

articles.title: New 200GB GTA 5 leak suggests Rockstar Games scrapped a massive Liberty City DLC, and reportedly includes very early GTA 6 work
articles.summary: Rockstar Games ' latest leak seemingly includes a nearly 200GB version of GTA 5 's source code, suggesting the developer started and then scrapped plans for a Liberty City DLC, alongside very early files related to GTA 6.
body: The Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption maker has dealt with quite a lot of leakage these last few years, and new online reports now indicate the tap is still dripping. The leaks apparently total around 192GB of newly accessible files, reportedly revealing tons of stuff cut from GTA 5.

Fans have eagerly been combing through the data and it looks like they've unearthed everything from cut dialogue, scrapped missions, unused assets, a really rough version of GTA 6's map and ambitious GTA 5 DLC plans that never crossed the finish line, including several files reportedly related to Liberty City. YouTuber TJGM even posted an outline of the supposed Liberty City DLC map's shoreline, showing off a much larger playable space than GTA 4's take on New York City.

"This isn't a screenshot included in the leak," they tweeted after. "This is data viewed in CodeWalker and then screenshotted after. It also includes many other Rockstar tools, source code and other things that are legit and easily verifiable."

body: Warriors of Light can pick up the quest that begins the crossover starting on Sept. 24, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. PDT. You'll have just a few weeks to complete it and collect all of the collaboration's rewards, as the event concludes on Oct. 13, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. PDT. The Nocturne for Heroes event first ran in 2021 and returned in 2024, so don't expect that you'll be able to play it again anytime soon after this year's revival concludes. You won't be able to start the event unless you have a character that is level 50, and you've completed the main scenario quest, "The Ultimate Weapon."

articles.title: Despite controversial reviews and online mockery, Marvel's Wolverine looks to have sold 1.9m on PS5 - and over 1 in 5 sales are physical
articles.summary: Marvel's Wolverine has been in the hot seat over the last week or so, but mixed reviews and internet memes seemingly haven't put a dent in the superhero game's adamantium frame.
body: Alinea Analytics' Rhy Elliot today reported that Marvel's Wolverine has moved around 1.9 copies in its first three days and, thus, dropped a fat bag of cash into PlayStation's lap. The figure apparently includes a million copies that came from pre-launch digital pre-orders. Altogether, the divisive action game's made upwards of $130m so far.

While Sony itself plans on ending production of discs for new PlayStation games in 2028, there seems to be plenty of demand for physical versions of its new blockbuster. According to the report, 22.9% of sales came from physical editions.

Interestingly, Marvel's Wolverine's physical-to-digital ratio is slightly heavier on the digital side than some of the PS5's other big hitters. A previous Alinea Analytics report claimed Insomniac Games' last superpowered romp, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, made 35% of its PS5 revenue from physical sales. Around 46% of Astro Bot 's sales also came from disc-based copies, while Ghost of Yotei 's physical split was 37.6%.
Keep in mind, Marvel's Wolverine hasn't been on store shelves for very long at all and the holiday season could well make a difference in that percentage split over the coming weeks and months.

articles.title: 'The PC platform is becoming more and more important,' Take-Two chief says, as we continue to wonder when we're going to get GTA 6
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is coming! Not to us on Team PC, mind: It will eventually, but right now it's a strict console exclusive. Why? Hard to say: Publisher Take-Two Interactive has taken pains to reassure PC gamers that they're very important and loved, but also, y'know, not now.
body: The latest reassurance to gamers on personal computers came during Take-Two's annual shareholders meeting, held yesterday, during which Take-Two chairman and CEO Strauss Zelnick was asked about the potential impact of PlayStation 5 Pro shortages —ironically, driven at least in part by the looming launch of GTA 6—on the company's plans for releasing the game on PC.

After clarifying that the question is really about "the cadence of PC launches," Zelnick continued, "The strategy of the company is over time, generally speaking, to launch for any platforms for which there's a meaningful audience. But that isn't always the case, and certainly if platforms were no longer viable, we would change that strategy. And I would note that the PC platform is becoming more and more important to our company over time."
So, what does that mean? Essentially, that Zelnick doesn't want to talk about it: GTA 6, for better or worse, is a console exclusive, and that's clearly where the studio's focus is.

videos.summary: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan discuss the diverging paths Xbox and PlayStation appear to be taking in this console generation, and it isn't the first time.
points: This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan discuss the diverging paths Xbox and PlayStation appear to be taking in this console generation, and it isn't the first time.
Ever since the Xbox-PlayStation 2 days, the two competitors have found themselves trading wins every other console generation, with Sony seeing massive success with the PS2, then Microsoft with the…
Both have lost massive amounts of gamer good will in this gen, with Sony and Microsoft shuttering studios, cancelling projects, and pushing forward some very not-so-consumer-friendly business…
And is it time for Sony to start fresh with a new PlayStation 6 generation?

videos.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Launch Trailer — Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game is available now, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system:
body: The Heroic Games have begun!

Command your units across the map and fight to gain the upper hand in strategic, turn-based combat. Between matches, visit locations within the city of Dagsion to prepare for battle by recruiting allies, honing your skills at the training ground, and strengthening your bonds. Or venture out into the surrounding lands to complete quests, gather resources, defeat roaming enemies, and more.
Follow the paths of four Heroes and fight to save the future from ruin in Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave.
